type "Sub FixOrder
Dim oComps, oComp, oDoc, sUrl, aNames, i
oComps = StarDesktop.Components.createEnumeration()
Do While oComps.hasMoreElements()
oComp = oComps.nextElement()
sUrl = """"
On Error Resume Next
sUrl = oComp.getURL()
On Error Goto 0
If InStr(sUrl, ""workbook-with-sample-database"") > 0 Then
oDoc = oComp
End If
Loop
aNames = Array(""ReadMe"",""Raw_data"",""Beans"",""Millet"",""Sorghum"",""Mkt Gotheye"",""Mkt Mangaize"",""Mkt Ouallam"",""Mkt Tera"",""Millet spatial integration"")
For i = 0 To UBound(aNames)
oDoc.Sheets.moveByName(aNames(i), i)
Next i
oDoc.store()
MsgBox ""DONE""
End Sub"
